## Portfolio experience check

- [ ] The change preserves existing public content and links.
- [ ] The purpose, audience, and career signal are clear.
- [ ] Metadata is complete and uses the shared taxonomy.
- [ ] The writing follows the experience standard and Eduardo's voice.
- [ ] Evidence, sources, and limits are proportionate to the claim.
- [ ] No sensitive, confidential, personal, or raw academic content is included.
- [ ] Spanish and English have been considered and linked where appropriate.
- [ ] Catalog and related area pages are current.
